newsitem.title: FRANCE: Valeo says in China joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Valeo says in China joint venture.

text.p: French car parts maker Valeo said on Thursday it had signed a joint venture agreement with Chinese commercial vehicle maker Yuejin Motor Corporation to make clutches.
Valeo said in a statement the agreement was subject to approval by Chinese authorities.

Each company will hold 50 percent in the new venture, called Nanjing Valeo Clutch Company. It will based in Nankin and will use a production site which supplies both Chinese and foreign constructors in China.
Valeo said the joint venture will be its fifth in China.
